campaign: B4-S3: the declared-index scan differential (compact indexed scan against the resident oracle and the contract model)
format: Same form as tests/compact_b4_mutants.json. These mutants sit in code that lane A4 adds (the compact arm of Database::search_in_at and the compact exact scan) or that the differential shares between the two arms, so the list applies to a tree that carries A4's patches. Replay with tests/compact_mutant_replay.py.
